mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, it is a clear 81 degrees near the Verona Public Library. Please note the air quality index is at a moderate level of 51. Looking ahead to tonight, we will see a waning gibbous moon, an overnight low of 63 degrees, and no rain expected.

The City of Verona manages the local cemetery and accepts applications for plot purchases. Additionally, the public works department is encouraging residents to install rain barrels, offering a 30 dollar rebate per unit to help manage stormwater runoff.

We have plenty happening locally, starting with yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus or Lake Lou-ee, and Wednesday brings more trivia at the Bogey Factory alongside the downtown farmer's market.
In our weekly police report, on August 2, a Verona man was located and taken into custody for bail jumping and resisting an officer after fleeing from a previous encounter.

The flavor of the day at Culver's is the delicious Really Reese's. If you miss out, tomorrow's flavor will be OREO Cookie Cheesecake. Culver's is currently open, so there is still time to stop by for a treat.
